items.title: Denise Morel Interview, 1965-05-07
items.q: He was an engineer. He had studied math. He played trumpet. He wrote songs... He also wrote a theater piece.

ctx.x: And did you tell the other things he did other than play trumpet?

He was an engineer. He had studied math. He played trumpet. He wrote songs. He wrote very beautiful songs. They are now very popular. They are now completely popular. They are recorded by many singers.
